_meta.description: Knowledge-cutoff dates (YYYY-MM-DD) per target_model_id, consumed by sensitivity_analyses.py --model-cutoffs. Keys prefixed with '_' are documentation and are ignored by the analysis (they never match a target_model_id).
_meta.metric: Training-data cutoff for Anthropic models (Anthropic publishes both a 'reliable knowledge cutoff' and a broader 'training data cutoff'; the latter is used here). For all other providers the single published knowledge/training cutoff is used.
_meta.day_convention: Month-only published cutoffs are pinned to the last day of that month (story_date > cutoff is the post-cutoff indicator). Cutoffs already published as a specific day are kept verbatim.

estimated.note: No knowledge cutoff is publicly documented for these models (all released Apr-May 2026). The model's RELEASE DATE is used as a conservative proxy and should be treated as an estimate, not a sourced cutoff.

sources.anthropic: platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/models/overview (Opus 4.7 & Sonnet 4.6 training cutoff Jan 2026; Sonnet 4 training cutoff Mar 2025)
